info.name: JFrog Artifactory REST API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API for managing artifacts, repositories, security, and system configuration in JFrog Artifactory. Provides endpoints for CRUD operations on repositories and artifacts, user and group management, permission targets, storage information, and system-level operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog Support
 Email: support@jfrog.com
